messages:
aj: noticing a spike in mTLS rejects for service-to-service calls in ap-south and eu-west, started ~03:41UTC. downstream services seeing 401s.
lena: any TLS logs? cert errors?
aj: example from ingress: 
`tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: bad certificate`
plus cert-manager logs: ```
2026-06-15T03:42:09Z cert-manager[issuer] ERROR sign: kms.SignAccessDenied: not authorized to perform kms:Sign on key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/abcd
issuer=cert-manager region=eu-west-1
```
omar: wait, we use KMS to sign CSRs for our short-lived node certs, right? if Sign fails, cert-manager returns a self-signed fallback which ingress rejects because CA chain changed.
ops-oncall: created INC-4984 and tagged SEV-2. attaching initial traces.
security-bot: Alert: KMS_SIGN_DENIED (ID KMS-4801). Link -> INC-4984.
lena: timeline checklist: 1) who rolled RBAC changes last 24h? 2) which KMS grants changed? 3) any policy automation jobs?
chandra: I saw an infra RBAC rollout at 02:55UTC (PR #8499) that simplified serviceAccount bindings for signing services. maybe over-eager.
aj: CloudTrail shows a PutKeyPolicy for the key at 02:56UTC from infra-ci-bot.
devsec: can we confirm the exact missing action? Sign vs Decrypt? we need the precise permission to restore.
aj: error shows kms:Sign denied. cert-manager needs Sign and DescribeKey.
omar: quick mitigation options: 1) re-add kms:Sign principal to key policy 2) add a KMS grant for the role 3) roll back RBAC automate change. Re-adding policy is fastest but must be audited.
lena: please run `aws kms get-key-policy` first and paste diff.
ops-oncall: fetched policy, diff: ```diff
-    "Principal": {"AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::111:role/cert-signer"]},
+    "Principal": {"AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::111:role/cert-reader"]},
```
ops-oncall: looks like cert-signer role was replaced by cert-reader. that's the break.
security-bot: Reminder: key-policy changes require ticket annotation and must pass review unless emergency.
aj: i'm going to apply a scoped grant with aws kms create-grant to give the cert-signer role Sign+Describe for a short window. command: 
```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/abcd --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111:role/cert-signer --operations Sign DescribeKey --name "temp-cert-sign-grant" --region eu-west-1
```
chandra: will that be accepted cross-account? check if key is multi-account.
ops-oncall: running the create-grant now and noting INC-4984. hold.
ops-oncall: grant created, cert-manager restarted -> certs issued. ingress mTLS OK in eu-west.
aj: ap-south still showing rejects, checking key alias there.
omar: ap-south uses a different key alias; looks like the same RBAC automation applied there too and removed signer role.
ops-oncall: creating grant in ap-south as well, done. services recovering.
lena: good short-term. follow-ups: 1) revert PR #8499 until we have KMS preflight (aj) 2) add CI preflight job to validate key policies won't drop signer principals (chandra) 3) update RBAC rollout runbook with KMS check and emergency grant play (ops-oncall).
devsec: also add a saved CloudTrail/ES query for PutKeyPolicy and CreateGrant events so we can find accidental changes fast. sample ES: ```json
{ "query": { "bool": { "must": [ {"match": {"eventName": "PutKeyPolicy"}}, {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "now-1d"}}} ] } } }
```
security-bot: Note: temporary grants expire when the corresponding KMS key is rotated or the grant is retired. track and revoke if not required.
aj: small vuln triage note: this change exposed a blast radius where RBAC changes affected KMS principal mapping. need to document threat model: if a maintainer can edit RBAC, they might accidentally remove crypto principals.
chandra: proposing GitLab CI job outline: 1) for each env, fetch expected principals from config 2) aws kms get-key-policy & get-grants 3) diff against expected 4) fail rollout if mismatch. i'll post MR tomorrow.
lena: assign postmortem to aj. include timeline, root cause, and action owners.
ops-oncall: INC-4984 -> mitigated, services recovered, closing incident as mitigated. created follow-up tasks in infra backlog.
aj: thanks everyone. will draft postmortem and link PRs. :thumbsup:
